quest.title: The Proscribed, Hidden in Plain Sight
quest.description: Although you met a familiar face, you have obtained no leads on Childe so far. Did you miss something that's hidden in plain sight?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1425, Primogem x30, Mora x62225, Hero's Wit x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x11

chapter.title: To the Stars Shining in the Depths

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's beat... but after so many shifts, it seems we're really getting the hang of it now.

choices.text: It does seem to be getting easier.

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Hey there, fellow shift-mates! I saw you just finished your work so I thought I'd come over and say hi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, hey there! We've seen you before, your assigned workspace is really close, isn't it?

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Haha, that's right. The name's Rowan. These past few days I couldn't help but notice the new faces working nearby, I guess we were destined to meet.

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: I've been working here for almost 15 years. Even the foreman, Grainville, always calls me "Chief."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, you've been working here a long time, Chief!

choices.text: Hey, Chief.

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Hahaha... If there's anything you'd like to know, just ask me. I know the work here in the production zone better than the back of my hand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, Chief! We'll be sure to come to you first!

choices.text: I think I've got the work more or less down pat...

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Did you just ask about... the "rules"?

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Heh, pretty sharp for newcomers. You've already heard about the "rules," huh? ...Who'd you hear it from?

choices.text: I don't think you need to know that.

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Hmm... Alright, seeing as I'm the one who came over here and you're already callin' me "Chief," I guess I can tell you a little.

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Truth is, you two keep workin' like this, you might be puttin' yourselves in danger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Wait, there's even a rule about that? What would've happened if you never told us about this...?

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Well, it's usually not that easy to break one on accident... The conditions of the "hidden rules" are usually pretty specific, but once you do break one, bad things happen.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So the conditions in this case are...?

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: If you work continuously in the production zone for three days, and if all you do besides eating and sleeping is just work...

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Then something bad will happen during lunch on the third day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh! Like what!? Oooh, don't scare Paimon!

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Heh, if I knew that, then I wouldn't be standing here talking to you, now would I?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean, even you have never tried working three days like that before?

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: There's actually a legend about this rule...

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: They say that there was a worker who worked way harder than me. He was both efficient and eager on the job, and most other workers couldn't hold a candle to him.

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: One time, he tried to test his limits and worked as long as he could. Then, during lunch on the third day...

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: He disappeared into thin air, as if he'd evaporated. Later, some people went and asked some of his past friends about him, but they said... "Never heard of the guy."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What the...!? How could that happen?

choices.text: What did that worker look like?

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Unfortunately, we were assigned different production zones. I never saw for myself what he looked like.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, are you thinking that it was...

choices.text: Thank you very much for the information.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: Oh?

response.speaker: Rowan
response.text: You... *sigh* Listen, kid, this ain't the kind of thing you should be curious about. Let me tell you, you're better off forgetting about it and looking after yourself. Now I kinda regret ever telling you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, I agree with Chief here... Do you really want to try?

choices.text: It sounds like a good lead to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, alright... If you insist...

choices.text: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
We'll give it a try...
Did you ever see him?
The "hidden rules"... That's what they're called, right?
We just haven't quite learned all the "rules."
In other words, you haven't managed any improvement in 15 years.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Not so loud...

choices.text: All you do is float around telling me what to do.

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: Your strength really shouldn't be underestimated. Now I get why you're prohibited from participating in any official fights.

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: Nobody who values their life would be willing to get in the ring with you.

choices.text: You flatter me.

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: However... You two haven't tried betting on the outcome of a pankration match yet, have ya?

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: Just go talk to Roussimoff. Buy a ticket for whichever fighter you think will win. There's a big payout if the fighter you support comes out on top.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we don't know anything about the fighters! How can we possibly know who to support...

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: That's normal, just watch a few matches and get a feel for the fighters. It won't be long before you can pick winners in your sleep.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's got a point... Why don't we give it a try? If we have enough coupons, we could probably bet at random until we figure everything out!

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: Bet at random, huh? Uh... Well, how should I put it? It's not like you can't do that, but I'd advise you to give it some more thought first, you wouldn't want to get too carried away, eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? We shouldn't get carried away? What's the problem?

choices.text: Could it be that...

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: Never even picked a boxer before and you already know about the "rules"? You're not just strong fighters, seems you're pretty perceptive, too.

choices.text: Just a guess, that's all.

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: Ah, might as well tell you about it, since you already know that much... Plus, I think you've got the potential to be one of my greatest customers, I think I can let you in a bit.

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: Besides, I don't want to risk ever losing a customer like you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, is it that serious?

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: OK, the "hidden rule" here is... If you buy both boxers' tickets and support them both...

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: Something bad will happen the next morning...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the rule is that we shouldn't pick both boxers in the same fight? But if anyone actually did that, wouldn't they be guaranteed to lose coupons... Who would do that anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And what do you mean by "something bad will happen"?

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: How would I know? Not like I'm stupid enough to do that.

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: But I've heard a story about the rule...

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: According to the rumor, there was a masked boxer who possessed incredible skill and power. None of his opponents even stood a chance against him...

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: However, in the final match, the organizers told him to take off his mask. He refused, and never showed up to the fight.

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: And after that, he was never seen again. Some say he died, or that he was taken care of by the event's organizers. But everyone remembers that he was someone who cherished honor above all else...

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: In his eyes, supporting both boxers in a match would dishonor the competition itself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, you mean... It's like a curse? He'll take vengeance on anyone who does that?

choices.text: Do you know anything about him?

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: No, he was always wearing a mask, like he was intentionally trying to hide his identity. I don't even know anything about his past.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you think that boxer was...

choices.text: Thank you very much for the information.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh! We will!?

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: You're not serious, are you?

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: Look, here I was just trying to be nice and warn you, yet here you are trying to break it on purpose?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, it sounds pretty scary to Paimon...

choices.text: It sounds like a good lead to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Seems you've made up your mind... Just be sure to protect Paimon, okay?

response.speaker: Collins
response.text: Betting on both fighters will set you back about 3,000 Credit Coupons. If you have enough, then go ahead and give it a try... Just don't come running back to me if something happens.

choices.text: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
We'll give it a try...
Have you seen what he really looks like?
The "hidden rules"... That's what they're called, right?
There's some sort of "rule" here?
Can't know for sure if you don't let me have a go.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's spend some coupons to skip work. (-400 Credit Coupons)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Though it feels nice to slack off a little, less work means less coupons... Let's make the most of our morning!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So after working for a few days straight, we got some strange meat in our lunch... What was that all about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, has our investigation turned up anything useful recently?

choices.text: I think I've got something...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Then it looks like that part of the investigation has hit a dead end.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, we'll keep searching for more clues tomorrow. Good night, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: But unfortunately, it's not related to Childe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A mysterious box, a bottle of crimson liquid... Paimon still doesn't know what to make of it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Do you have any ideas, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: I think I've got something...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Then it looks like that part of the investigation led us nowhere...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, maybe we'll have better luck tomorrow. Good night, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: But unfortunately, it's not related to Childe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's exhausted, it's just work, work, and more work... Paimon's little body can't handle this much longer...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a sec, now that Paimon thinks about it... Haven't we been working nonstop for three days now? And now it's lunchtime!

choices.text: Mm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon feels a shiver going down her spine! What's going to happen?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it doesn't seem like anything's changed at all... And we made it to the Coupon Cafeteria safely.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are the so-called "hidden rules" only a rumor, after all?

choices.text: Don't get your hopes up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, there's no use just guessing all day. Paimon's stomach has been grumbling the whole time, let's just eat already...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wonders what we'll get today! Maybe we'll get the super lucky meal...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what!?

choices.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—What in the world is this!? What's with Paimon's food? And yours is the same...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is this stuff... meat? But it looks and feels so bizarre... What kind of chef would make food like this?

choices.text: I've never seen a welfare meal like this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do you think is going on, {NICKNAME}? Is this the "bad thing" that Rowan was talking about?

choices.text: Someone went missing before...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: N—no, stop right there, Paimon gets what you mean! Just don't say it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, isn't that Wolsey over there? He must've made the food, right? So let's just ask him about the food and be done with it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Wolsey! Have a moment?

response.speaker: Wolsey
response.text: Hmm, what is it? I'm about to go report the numbers for today's free meal, so you'd better make it quick.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, it's about the meat in our meals. Look, does it seem... normal to you?

response.speaker: Wolsey
response.text: The meat? Oh, that... It looks perfectly fine to me, totally normal. You'd better hurry up and chow down.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: H—How could THIS be fine? Hey! Don't leave! You barely even looked at it... HEY!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What should we do now? Wolsey wouldn't even give us the time of day... is he trying to hide something?

choices.text: Looks like we'll have to investigate it ourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, looks like we have no other choice. Paimon was positively famished a minute ago, but now she's lost her appetite...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What would you like to do this afternoon?

choices.text: The plot thickens.
And now our meals have this "strange meat"...
There's something wrong with this "meat."
This is...
That would be quite a disappointment.
You're just realizing that now?

dialogues.speaker: Fielding
dialogues.text: Hey, Traveler, Paimon! Package here for ya.

dialogues.speaker: Fielding
dialogues.text: The next time you buy something, go pick it up yourself. I'm not a deliveryman, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? A package... For us? Did you buy something, {NICKNAME}? *yawn* Paimon's not quite awake yet, so why don't you go take a look...

choices.text: I didn't buy anything.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right! Yesterday we broke the "hidden rule" and bought tickets for both boxers. Maybe this package is the "bad thing" that Collins said would happen...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon suddenly feels wide awake! Wait, maybe let Paimon go hide somewhere first. Just call for Paimon AFTER you've opened it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, wait, wait! Paimon's still here, don't open it! Ahh!

choices.text: Doesn't seem especially scary.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What is it? Are you okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: L—Let Paimon take a peek too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it's just a small bottle... but the color of the liquid inside looks so wrong, almost like...

choices.text: Hmm, rumor has it that a boxer went missing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, that's enough of that! No need to say it out loud, Paimon already knows what you're trying to say...

choices.text: Do you want to give it a sniff?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Blegh, no way! Get that stuff away from Paimon!

choices.text: Seems we'll have to investigate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks we shouldn't open the bottle until we've figured out what's going on. Just trust Paimon on this one, okay!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you plan on doing now?

choices.text: This place is chock-full of strange happenings after all...
Do you want to give it a taste?
And the liquid in the bottle obviously looks like blood...
But there is something a little odd inside.
Unless, this is...

dialogues.speaker: Grainville
dialogues.text: Look who decided to show up! Get your butts in gear and get to work, time's a-wasting!

choices.text: If possible...

response.speaker: Grainville
response.text: Oh? What's with suddenly wanting to work so hard? You need coupons that badly?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: S—Sure? Let's just say we really want to test our limits.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: To investigate the "hidden rules," you and Paimon start working despite the lack of clarity...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nice, we did well today! Let's keep it up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew, Paimon's had it... Who knew that processing these widgets would be so tiring?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's it... Paimon doesn't even have the energy to talk anymore... Is it time to eat yet?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: C'mon. Lunchtime for Paimon.

choices.text: I'd like to apply for three continuous working days.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After persuading Collins to lower the difficulty, you easily clear the challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Collins lowers the difficulty and you cruise through the game, but you receive fewer coupons.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go work in the production zone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go! Credit Coupons, here we come!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, we just need to keep at it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon really hopes the foreman will be in a better mood today...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's see if there's any really easy work...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's good to kick back and relax once in a while.

talks.objective: Go to the production zone to talk to Grainville

dialogues.speaker: Grainville
dialogues.text: Look who decided to show up! Get your butts in gear and get to work, time's a-wasting!

choices.text: Already on it!

response.speaker: Grainville
response.text: Good, here you go! Remember to give me the widget once you're finished processing it.

choices.text: Could you explain the job to me again?

response.speaker: Grainville
response.text: Your job is to use the machine over there to process these widgets.

response.speaker: Grainville
response.text: You step on the pedal when the timing is right. If the machine gets jammed, give it a good whack or two and it'll fix it right up. You got it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's end the shift.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright... By the way, it seems like we still haven't found all the clues regarding the strange liquid.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No more strange packages are gonna show up... right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Isn't this the super lucky meal!? Looks like hard work really does get rewarded!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's going to take her time and savor every bite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Just a regular meal set. Guess Paimon shouldn't get her hopes up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wh—What is this garbage!? Ugh, it looks disgusting... Aw, Paimon misses your cooking now, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Vidoc
dialogues.text: Well? Have you gotten used to prison life yet?

dialogues.speaker: Vidoc
dialogues.text: Shh... Save the questions for now. I don't like to give away information for no reason, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Grainville
dialogues.text: Let me have a look... Hmm, not bad. Right, here's your Credit Coupons.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm no quitter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow, giving it your all even when it's just a game. That's {NICKNAME} for ya!

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: #Oh? You must be {NICKNAME}, huh? Sorry, mate, but competitors as strong as you are prohibited from participating. I don't make the rules, mind you, but I was given very specific instructions...

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: Even convicts value their lives, don't they? I hope you can understand, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: But we have a game here that'll let you show off your strength, and you'll even earn some Credit Coupons in the process. What do you think? Interested?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And if we lose the game? Will it cost us Credit Coupons?

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: Of course! That's the cruel reality facing every competitor in a place like the Pankration Ring.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: OK. Great, let me walk you through the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: The targets in front of you will pop up one after another.

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: You'll need to hit the targets in the same order that they popped up. If you can complete a few rounds in a row with no mistakes, then you'll win Credit Coupons.

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: But the second you mess up the order, you lose. Game over.

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: The game costs 300 Credit Coupons to have a go. So, you up for it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have enough coupons...

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: Then come back once you've got enough coupons, I'll still be here to start the game for ya.

talks.objective: Complete what's planned for the morning

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You apply with Grainville to do some of the simpler processing tasks, and get some Credit Coupons without breaking a sweat.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As your concentration begins to slip and you rely more on muscle memory to complete the work, the quality of the finished widgets has dropped and you receive fewer coupons.

talks.objective: Apply to Grainville for three continuous working days
Walk around and look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sigewinne? Aren't you supposed to be in the infirmary? What are you doing in the production zone?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Everyone's usually busy around now, and we don't have any patients to look after in the infirmary, I thought I'd come here and enjoy the sight of everyone hard at work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Enjoy? What's there to enjoy here...?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: It's really worth watching... I often stand here and observe everyone. Humans are just so interesting and adorable, I like to watch your expressions while you work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Are you talking about pets or people?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you also happen to be a veterinarian as well as head nurse?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Oh... I can see why you'd think that, but you shouldn't jump to conclusions.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: See, we Melusines are a different species, and we see the world very differently from humans. It's very easy for me to observe everyone's condition. All it takes is one look and I can tell which workers are exhausted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, Melusines can see that? Huh, that does sound useful for being a nurse.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Yes, running around tending to everyone's health is very fulfilling, but I'd much prefer it if you were all happy and free from exhaustion and pain in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Take care of your body and make sure you eat well. Always rest when you're tired from work and don't push yourself too hard.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll definitely take care of ourselves, thanks for the reminder!

talks.objective: Walk around and look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey look, there's something here... looks like a research notebook.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That suspicious guy peeking into the infirmary just now... Is he a fan of Sigewinne?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He must have dropped this. Let Paimon read it real quick...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...The Melusine perceive the world very differently from humans, there are significant deviations...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...As a result, their sense of aesthetics and beauty is also very different from that of humans. This must be taken into consideration when giving gifts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, this all sounds pretty serious... He sure did his homework.

choices.text: Won't he object to us looking through his notes?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And as for the notebook... Let's take it.

choices.text: We should thank him for the intel.

talks.objective: Walk around and look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Rowan? What are you doing here, Chief?

dialogues.speaker: Rowan
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... I was injured a bit just now. Nothing major, I think I just pulled something. Little mishaps like this are unavoidable at work, y'know...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon wouldn't have thought someone as experienced as the Chief would still get hurt on the job...

dialogues.speaker: Rowan
dialogues.text: Tch, I just knew you would say that... This is pretty embarrassing... *sigh* Ugh, where is Sigewinne when you need her anyway? The one time I need to make a quick trip to the infirmary...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? You mean she wasn't in the infirmary?

dialogues.speaker: Rowan
dialogues.text: Yeah, the rumors say that there's never anybody in the infirmary in the half hour before lunch, and nobody knows where Sigewinne gets off to.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, that's actually really strange. Sigewinne's always super dedicated to her work, where else would she possibly go...?

dialogues.speaker: Rowan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Forget it, I can take care of a small sprain like this on my own anyway, no need to trouble her.

talks.objective: Walk around and look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: I heard you crazy fools really did it, you bought tickets to support both fighters, didn't ya? Well? Did anything happen?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, the next day we received a mysterious package, but we still haven't made any sense of the contents...

dialogues.speaker: Collins
dialogues.text: So it is real... You didn't become cursed or anything like that, did ya? Are you both still okay? Wait, are you sure that it's still you controlling your bodies right now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh, Paimon's not sure... What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Is Paimon still Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Only you'd ever ask such a question, so I'm pretty sure you're fine.
